title: Footer 05
description: Muted footer with a newsletter form, four link columns and a bottom line with the brand, copyright and legal links.

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { FooterNewsletter } from "@/registry/bases/base/blocks/footer-05/components/footer-05-newsletter" export type FooterDictionary = { newsletter: { title: string description?: string emailLabel: string emailPlaceholder: string subscribe: string } navLabel: string sections: { title: string; links: { label: string; href: string }[] }[] brand: { name: string; href: string } copyright: string legalLabel: string legal: { label: string; href: string }[] } export function Footer({ dictionary, lang, className, }: { dictionary: FooterDictionary lang: "en" | "ar" className?: string }) { const dir = lang === "ar" ? "rtl" : "ltr" return (
{/* Newsletter + link columns */}
{dictionary.sections.map((section) => (

{section.title}

    {section.links.map((link) => (
  • {link.label}
    • ))}
))}
{/* Brand + legal line */}
{dictionary.brand.name}
{dictionary.copyright}
{dictionary.legal.map((link) => ( • {link.label} ))}
